svg.aria-label: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the architecture
svg.title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the architecture

g.text: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the architecture
the card and its ask (6), the page that follows (7)
one run, with its cancel signal (4)
a turn's judge cost (2), the rows (3), stopped (4)
the judge hands back its cost (2)
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The web's pages call the eval routes through their client. The routes hand a run to the desk, which plays it with the eval library and can cancel it. The library's judge reads its own
cost. The records both sides share are the contracts. The number in brackets is the step.
